_comment: Syscall jail for the vulnerable PHP profile (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619). Deny-list over allow-by-default: requires no privileges or CAP_SYS_CHROOT, so it keeps the UID 101 + cap-drop ALL model. NOTE: execve CANNOT be denied here: the container runtime uses it to launch php itself (if denied, the container does not start: 'exec /usr/local/bin/php: operation not permitted'). Command execution is blocked at the PHP layer (disable_functions) and by the absence of a shell and any other binary in the image. This jail blocks the kernel escape and lateral-movement primitives (ptrace, mounts, namespaces, module loading, kexec, bpf).

syscalls.comment: Debugging other processes, namespace/mount manipulation, kernel module loading, kexec and bpf. None are used by a PHP/nginx web server; all are escape or lateral-movement vectors. execve is left allowed because the runtime needs it to start the container.
